newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends flat in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends flat in quiet market.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed unchanged at 42.5250/5300 to the dollar in a quiet interbank session on Saturday, dealers said.
"The market was absolutely quiet. There was almost no transaction between taka and dollar," said one dealer with a foreign bank.

Dealers said the market was dull due to virtually no demand for the U.S. currency, of which there was an adequate supply. The weekend closure of international markets further strained demand, they said.
Call money rates finished at 6.0 to 7.0 percent against Thursday's 6.25-6.75 percent. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
